caseNameFull: Richardson, Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare v. Wright and Wright v. Richardson, Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare

opinions.text: Appeals from D. C. D. C. Motion of appellants in No. 70-5211 for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Probable jurisdiction noted. Cases consolidated and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 321 F. Supp. 383.
